note: Barrel Goblins use the projectile-specific 1100 ms spawn delay, not the generic Goblin's 1000 ms deploy time. The Goblin Barrel attribute table and May 2019 change both specify 1.1 seconds. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Goblin_Barrel https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json

Both evolution projectiles inherit GoblinBarrelSpell without a spawn-delay override in the cached game data. Use its 1100 ms projectile-specific delay before the generic character default. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RoyaleAPI/cr-api-data/master/docs/json/cards_stats.json

The spawned Goblin deals direct melee damage. Zero disables a traveling attack projectile; it must not inherit the barrel transport speed. GoblinBarrelSpell.spawnCharacterData has damage and melee range with no projectileData. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json
Decoy Goblins also deal direct melee damage. GoblinBarrelSpell_EV1_Decoy.spawnCharacterData has no projectileData. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json
Spawned Skeletons have melee damage and no projectileData; they must not inherit the Witch's ranged attack. https://cache.statsroyale.com/gamedata-v5.json

Cursed Hogs use a direct melee attack against buildings, not the Mother Witch's projectile. Zero selects direct damage rather than an estimated projectile speed. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Mother_Witch
Guardienne's ordinary sword attack is melee; it must not inherit the Little Prince's crossbow projectile. Her charge remains a separate ability. https://clashroyale.fandom.com/wiki/Little_Prince
